statements: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'contractor_ro') THEN CREATE ROLE contractor_ro LOGIN; END IF; END $$;
REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE neondb FROM contractor_ro;
GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE neondb TO contractor_ro;
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM contractor_ro;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO contractor_ro;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO contractor_ro;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO contractor_ro;
